title: v0.9.59 — Rounded visuals and a calmer midgame

blocks.text: v0.9.59 brings soft, rounded depth to GOO BLASTER while keeping its top-down controls and collision rules.
Characters and enemies have gentle shading and ground shadows. Small, low-contrast terrain details add depth; enemy bodies reuse cached artwork.
Ordinary enemies shoot less frequently in Stages 7–19 to reduce midgame bullet pressure. Boss attacks and enemy counts are unchanged.
Nukes now trigger slow motion, a delayed blast and a lingering white flash. Goo puddles stay pale even when they overlap.
The stage goal is visible on the menu. Dash Training now explains the next cooldown and fixed invulnerability duration; its three upgrade levels keep their existing values.
Please tell me how Stage 9 feels, whether the nuke flash is comfortable, and whether the rounded visuals stay smooth on your phone. Desktop browser results do not establish phone performance.
v0.9.59 加入柔和圓潤的微 3D 光影，保留原本俯視操作與碰撞規則。
角色與敵人有柔和明暗和腳下陰影，地面加入低對比的小浮雕；敵人共用預先繪製的光影圖。
第 7–19 關普通小怪的射擊間隔放慢，減少中段彈幕壓力；Boss 攻擊與敵人數量不變。
核彈加入慢動作、延遲爆炸與白屏停留；地面果凍重疊時也保持淡色。
主畫面直接顯示關卡目標。衝刺訓練說明下一級冷卻與固定無敵時間，原有三級強化數值不變。
歡迎回報第 9 關難度、核彈白屏是否舒適，以及微 3D 在手機上是否順暢。桌機瀏覽器結果不能代替手機效能實測。

body_html:
English

v0.9.59 brings soft, rounded depth to GOO BLASTER while keeping its top-down controls and collision rules.

  • Characters and enemies have gentle shading and ground shadows. Small, low-contrast terrain details add depth; enemy bodies reuse cached artwork.
  • Ordinary enemies shoot less frequently in Stages 7–19 to reduce midgame bullet pressure. Boss attacks and enemy counts are unchanged.
  • Nukes now trigger slow motion, a delayed blast and a lingering white flash. Goo puddles stay pale even when they overlap.
  • The stage goal is visible on the menu. Dash Training now explains the next cooldown and fixed invulnerability duration; its three upgrade levels keep their existing values.

Please tell me how Stage 9 feels, whether the nuke flash is comfortable, and whether the rounded visuals stay smooth on your phone. Desktop browser results do not establish phone performance.

繁體中文

v0.9.59 加入柔和圓潤的微 3D 光影，保留原本俯視操作與碰撞規則。

  • 角色與敵人有柔和明暗和腳下陰影，地面加入低對比的小浮雕；敵人共用預先繪製的光影圖。
  • 第 7–19 關普通小怪的射擊間隔放慢，減少中段彈幕壓力；Boss 攻擊與敵人數量不變。
  • 核彈加入慢動作、延遲爆炸與白屏停留；地面果凍重疊時也保持淡色。
  • 主畫面直接顯示關卡目標。衝刺訓練說明下一級冷卻與固定無敵時間，原有三級強化數值不變。

歡迎回報第 9 關難度、核彈白屏是否舒適，以及微 3D 在手機上是否順暢。桌機瀏覽器結果不能代替手機效能實測。
